models.name: Bonsai 2 4B
models.why: The 0.95GB ternary 4B does 250-email batches on a MacBook Pro: 32 concurrent streams, under 4GB peak memory and over 700 tokens per second in total.

engines.quant: ternary 4B pack in a Nothing-OS style chat app with web search and cross-chat memory; the same build runs the 2B at 10-11 tok/s
32 concurrent streams processing 250 emails into JSON (summaries, action items, calendar events, priority scoring); peak memory under 4GB, >700 tok/s in total

models.name: Bonsai 2 2B (iPhone)
models.why: The 0.43GB ternary 2B runs twice as fast as the 4B on the same phone (10-11 vs 5-6 tok/s) and is the family's target for on-device agents.

engines.quant: ternary 2B pack beside the 4B in the same app; 10-11 tok/s vs 5-6 tok/s for the 4B

models.name: Raon-1 mini
models.why: A 30B MoE from KRAFTON whose 262K context costs about 1GB of KV (only 7 of 25 layers keep a KV cache), so long context is nearly free: 23.6 tok/s decode on an 8GB RTX 3070 with experts on CPU, versus 19.1 tok/s for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on the same box. Needs KRAFTON's llama.cpp fork for now.

engines.hardware: RTX 3070 8GB + 64GB DDR4, 6.4GB VRAM used at 262K context
engines.quant: Q4_K_M 19.7GB file; KRAFTON's llama.cpp fork (raon-1-mini-preview branch, upstream does not load it yet); experts from 20 of 25 layers on CPU, Q8 KV cache, 262K context; prefill 388 tok/s
engines.engine_min_version: KRAFTON llama.cpp fork, branch raon-1-mini-preview; llama-server --ctx-size 262144 --n-cpu-moe 20 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0

engines.quant: IQ4_XS GGUF; KRAFTON's llama.cpp fork; -ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 13 -c 262144 -fa on --jinja -np 1 -t 8, Q8 KV cache; ~825 tok/s prefill; full 262K context costs ~1GB at q8
engines.engine_min_version: KRAFTON llama.cpp fork, branch raon-1-mini-preview; -ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 13 -c 262144 -fa on

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B
models.why: Hybrid GPU + system-RAM llama.cpp inference puts the full 125B on a single 24GB RTX 4090 at ~21 tok/s decode right out to 250K context, with VRAM at 18.3GB and 110GB of DDR4 holding the experts.

engines.quant: Q4_K_XL GGUF ~111.4GB across four shards; hybrid GPU + CPU expert offload (40 expert layers on the GPU); no MTP, no DFlash2, no KV-cache quant; 23.85GB VRAM of 24GB; prefill 384 tok/s at 80K context
engines.engine_min_version: experimental llama.cpp build with -cmoe expert offload

engines.hardware: RTX 4090 24GB + 110GB DDR4 system RAM, Ubuntu 22 (18.3GB VRAM used)
engines.quant: Q4_K_XL GGUF ~111.4GB four shards; hybrid GPU + system-RAM expert offload; no MTP, no DFlash2, no KV-cache quantization; decode at 250K context, prefill 364 tok/s
engines.engine_min_version: experimental llama.cpp build with -cmoe expert offload
